title: The Relic Thieves
text: Thieves have robbed a pilgrims' caravan of its relic and fled into the hills, leaving one guard dead in the road. The pilgrims kneel in the dust, tearing their clothes, and beg for help. Their tracks are still fresh.

options.label: Chase the thieves into the hills, and win back what was stolen.

outcomes.text: They fight for it, and lose, and the pilgrims sing your names.

options.label: The sharpest eye tracks them to their hideout, to catch them unawares.

outcomes.text: Asleep, the lot of them. You take back the relic, and their loot.

options.label: The Leader buys the relic from the thieves, and keeps it for the House.

outcomes.text: A relic is a relic. The pilgrims will never know who has it.
